entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text:
The criminal revision has been preferred praying for quashing of the proceeding in Barasat Police Station Case No. 371 of 2024 dated June 26, 2024 under Sections 498A/323/406 of the Indian Penal Code (G.R. Case No. 2642 of 2024) pending before the learned Judicial Magistrate, 2nd Court,
Barasat.
2.

entities.text: Barasat Police Station Case No. 371 of 2024
entities.label: ORG

entities.text: Indian Penal Code (G.R. Case No. 2642 of 2024
entities.label: STATUTE

sentences.text: Considering the nature of allegation and the materials on record, the revisional application is required to be heard in presence of the opposite parties.
3. Petitioner to serve upon all the parties and file affidavit of service on the next date of hearing.
4. Considering the nature of allegation, the proceeding in Barasat P.S. Case No. 371 of 2024 be stayed till disposal of the revisional application.
5. Matter to appear in the Combined Monthly List of November, 2025.

( Shampa Dutt (Paul), J. )
